name: ruling-11-item-failing-the-common-when-is-no-kind
reference: spec 0.30 ruling 11: the common `when` of a group body may carry `as`; the key is set on every item that decodes, and the encode rules for a common `when` apply per item; 4 is outside 1..3: the item is no-kind (ruling 27 of 0.8, ruling 11 of 0.20)
